subtasks.subtask: 1.1: Create Supabase project (or verify existing project)
1.2: Navigate to Project Settings → Database → Connection string
1.3: Copy DATABASE_URL (pooled connection - Transaction mode)
1.4: Copy DIRECT_URL (direct connection - Session mode)
1.5: Navigate to Project Settings → API → Copy Supabase URL
1.6: Copy anon/public key (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)
1.7: Copy service_role key (SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY)
1.8: Document all connection strings securely
2.1: Log into Stripe Dashboard (create account if needed)
2.2: Use test mode for initial setup
2.3: Navigate to Developers → API keys
2.4: Copy Publishable key (NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY)
2.5: Copy Secret key (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY)
2.6: Navigate to Developers → Webhooks → Add endpoint (placeholder for now)
2.7: Note: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET will be set up in Epic 5
3.1: Log into Resend Dashboard (create account if needed)
3.2: Navigate to API Keys section
3.3: Create new API key with appropriate permissions
3.4: Copy RESEND_API_KEY
4.1: Open package.json
4.2: Add "postinstall": "prisma generate" to scripts section
4.3: Verify prisma is in dependencies (not just devDependencies) for Vercel
4.4: Test locally: run npm install and verify Prisma client generates
5.1: Ensure .env.example has all required keys documented
5.2: Add comments explaining each variable
5.3: Verify .env.local is in .gitignore
6.1: Log into Vercel Dashboard
6.2: Click "Add New..." → "Project"
6.3: Import the marmorani GitHub repository
6.4: Select Framework Preset: Next.js
6.5: Configure Root Directory if needed (should be project root)
6.6: Set Build Command: npm run build (default)
6.7: Set Output Directory: .next (default)
7.1: In Vercel Project Settings → Environment Variables
7.2: Add DATABASE_URL (Production, Preview, Development)
7.3: Add DIRECT_URL (Production, Preview, Development)
7.4: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL (all environments)
7.5: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (all environments)
7.6: Add SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY (Production only for security)
7.7: Add STRIPE_SECRET_KEY (Production, Preview)
7.8: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY (all environments)
7.9: Add STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (Production - placeholder or real if set up)
7.10: Add RESEND_API_KEY (Production, Preview)
7.11: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL (Production: final domain, Preview: use VERCEL_URL)
8.1: Push latest code to main branch (or trigger deploy from Vercel)
8.2: Monitor build logs in Vercel Dashboard
8.3: Verify build completes successfully
8.4: Verify Prisma generate runs during postinstall
8.5: Check deployment is marked as "Ready"
9.1: Access production URL from Vercel Dashboard
9.2: Verify homepage loads with correct layout (Header, Footer)
9.3: Test locale routing: /en/, /fr/, /it/, /es/, /de/
9.4: Verify language switcher works in production
9.5: Check browser console for errors
10.1: Create a test branch with a minor change
10.2: Open a pull request to main
10.3: Verify Vercel automatically creates preview deployment
10.4: Access preview URL and verify it loads correctly
10.5: Verify environment variables work in preview
10.6: Close/merge the test PR
11.1: Run npm run build locally - no errors
11.2: Run npm run lint locally - no errors
11.3: Production site loads and functions correctly
11.4: Document production URL in project README or docs

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: GitHub repository is connected to Vercel project; Vercel project created and linked to the marmorani GitHub repository; Automatic deployments triggered on push to main branch

All environment variables configured in Vercel: DATABASE_URL, DIRECT_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, RESEND_API_KEY, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL

Preview deployments work for pull requests; PR branches automatically trigger preview deployments; Preview URLs are accessible and functional; Environment variables are available in preview deployments
Prisma client generation runs during build; postinstall script configured in package.json with prisma generate; Build process successfully generates Prisma client; No Prisma-related build errors

Production URL is accessible and serves the base layout; Production deployment accessible via Vercel URL; Homepage loads with Header, Footer, and locale routing; All 5 locales (/en/, /fr/, /it/, /es/, /de/) work in production
Build completes without errors; npm run build succeeds on Vercel; No TypeScript errors; No ESLint errors

constraints.constraint: Vercel Deployment: Native Next.js hosting with automatic CDN, serverless functions, and edge caching
Supabase Integration: Managed PostgreSQL with connection pooling required for serverless environment
Environment Isolation: All secrets via environment variables, never committed to repo
Prisma in Serverless: Requires postinstall script to generate client during build
Supabase provides two connection strings: Pooled (Transaction mode) for DATABASE_URL, Direct (Session mode) for DIRECT_URL
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be Production only for security
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is Production only (placeholder acceptable for now)
npm run build must succeed without TypeScript or ESLint errors
Prisma generate must run during postinstall for Vercel compatibility
All 5 locales (/en/, /fr/, /it/, /es/, /de/) must work in production

interface.name: Environment Variables
interface.signature: DATABASE_URL: PostgreSQL pooled connection string (Supabase Transaction mode) DIRECT_URL: PostgreSQL direct connection string (Supabase Session mode) NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL: Supabase project URL (public) NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: Supabase anonymous key (public) SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: Supabase service role key (server-only) STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: Stripe secret key (server-only) NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY: Stripe publishable key (public) STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: Stripe webhook signing secret (server-only) RESEND_API_KEY: Resend email API key (server-only) NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL: Application base URL (public)
interface.path: Vercel Dashboard → Project Settings → Environment Variables

interface.name: Vercel Build Process
interface.signature: 1. npm install runs → triggers postinstall → prisma generate runs 2. npm run build runs → Next.js builds the application 3. Deployment serves static assets from CDN, API routes as serverless functions

interface.name: Prisma Database Configuration
interface.signature: prisma.config.ts: defineConfig({ datasource: { url: env("DATABASE_URL") } }) schema.prisma: generator client { provider = "prisma-client", output = "../src/generated/prisma" }
